name: Oat Porridge
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup (45 g) rolled oats or other grain

steps: Mix oats and water, then bring to the boil, covered with a lid.
Once bubbling, stir and reduce temperature to the lowest possible to maintain simmering. Replace lid and watch carefully to prevent boiling over.
Stir every minute or so. After five minutes, remove lid, stir thoroughly and add milk.
Mix through, and keep stirring until fully mixed.
Serve and add raisins, sugar, brown sugar, maple syrup, a pinch of salt, honey or inverted sugar syrup to taste.

culture.text: Porridge is a type of semi-solid food made by soaking, poaching or boiling, in milk or water, ground, crushed or chopped starchy plants, typically grain. It is a traditional staple food of many countries.
